name: Systems Theory in Mechatronics
description: Interested students may put up questions and topics for discussion consolidating the lecture's content and topics beyond. Prof. Lohmann develops derivations at the board, gives more detailed informations and discusses the corresponding literature references.
prerequisites:
A prerequisite is the introductory lecture "Automatic Control". Moreover, a mathematical background regarding analysis and linear algebra from the basic courses in mathematics is required.
Attendance of the lecture "Systems Theory in Mechatronics"
